javac Points Most Method References Straight at the Method, With No lambda$ Method in Between

'A bound receiver needs no adapter.' Summary: 'only varargs, array constructors and super:: got a lambda$ adapter'. So Order::total and audit::record get none, and t -> t * 2 gets one.

recorded.outcome:q-null-name-trace: Stack-trace section: 'ref: java.lang.NullPointerException' with top frame 'ReferencePipeline$3$1.accept'; 'the top frame is the stream's, no frame names our code, and the NPE has no message'. Summary: 'A reference to a JDK method that meets a null element gives a trace with no line of ours and no NPE message.'
